mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500 million MoM, coupled with HOUST growth above 10,000 units MoM, indicates robust demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > $500M and HOUST MoM growth > 10,000
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS rate increase above 2% within a 3-month window signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS 3-month increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: UNRATE's level, as a standalone indicator, provides a persistent positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to its inverse relationship with labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no significant correlation with UNRATE levels (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 0.5% MoM, without exceeding 2% YoY, indicates controlled inflation with strong demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL MoM growth > 0.5% and YoY growth < 2%
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
